title: Heat capacity, heating curves, and calorimetry
objective: Calculate heat, equilibrium temperature, phase-change energy, and reaction heat in coffee-cup or bomb calorimetry.

blocks.alt: A rising line for warming a solid, a horizontal melting plateau, a rising liquid line, a horizontal boiling plateau, and a final rising gas line.

blocks.title: Common errors
blocks.md: Use $T_f-T_i$. Do not insert phase-change energy in $mc\Delta T$. Check whether the heat capacity is total or per gram. A warming solution means negative reaction heat.

blocks.title: Exam practice
blocks.md: Expect a supplied specific heat, calorimeter constant, or phase-change enthalpy in a numerical question. Track J and kJ and whether the answer is per mole.
